relations: As the raised knee lowers toward the court, the airborne player descends from the leaping pose toward an upright stance.
When the two-handed grip narrows to one arm beside the pole, that arm extends upward to push the ball.
If the arm extends fully, the ball climbs in front of the backboard, past the rim toward the top edge.
As the ball rises, the player leans back beneath it, head up, while the framing tightens on hoop and pole.
caption: The video captures an outdoor basketball court with a single hoop, transparent backboard and white support pole rising from a reddish surface, bordered by grass and trees. A person in a pale t‑shirt and black shorts is airborne near the pole, one knee raised and both hands cradling a basketball just left of the rim. As the action unfolds, the raised knee eventually drops and the player lowers toward the court, shifting from a leaping pose to a more upright stance. The torso turns into a side profile and the grip narrows to a single arm, which reaches up beside the pole. That guiding arm extends fully, sending the ball upward so it climbs in front of the backboard, past the rim and toward the top edge. The person leans back beneath the rising ball, head tilted up, while the arm follows its trajectory. The hoop, pole and trees shift slightly in the view as the framing tightens, and the ball remains high near the top edge as the video ends.
